name: Please Be Solved Pickering 2022
information:
### Blindfolded events only

The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### FMC Canada connection

This competition will be held during the morning/early afternoon on the same day as [FMC Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2022) in the same venue as the Pickering, ON location. You are welcome to register for one or both competitions, but please note that you would need to ***register for FMC Canada separately***.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.
